name: Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites

address.street: Praia Da Falésia Pinhal Do Concelho

insider_take: Perched dramatically on ochre cliffs 200 feet above pristine Atlantic waters, this architectural marvel seamlessly blends contemporary luxury with Portugal's stunning natural coastline.
whats_special: Pine Cliffs sits on one of Europe's most spectacular cliff-top locations along the famous Praia da Falésia, renowned for its golden-red limestone formations. The resort features Portugal's only clifftop golf course and direct access to one of the Algarve's most photographed beaches via a scenic funicular railway.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the clifftop restaurant - the view of the dramatic rock formations turning crimson at golden hour is absolutely unforgettable and perfect for Instagram.
dont_miss: The thrilling descent on the cliff funicular to reach the secluded beach below, and exploring the nearby picturesque fishing village of Olhos de Água, just a 10-minute walk along the coastal path with its traditional whitewashed houses and authentic Portuguese charm.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Atlantic Ocean views
Spacious suite accommodations with fully equipped kitchens
Direct access to Praia da Falésia golden sand beach
Comprehensive resort amenities including championship golf course and multiple pools
Part of prestigious Marriott STARS program with exclusive benefits
cons: Remote Algarve location requires travel planning to reach
